rationale: P identifies the collision-relevant driving state needed to establish whether braking is required and hence whether a required maneuver could be omitted. H-1, SG-1 and FR-7 support this relationship; FR-7.2.4 supports the on-or-near-trajectory scope. The references to detection and determining braking need frame the operational situation without incorporating sensing, computation, control execution or mechanism timing into P.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking-relevant driving state is the property to be characterised.
Obstacle or road-user presence on the trajectory, with scope extending to nearby objects, is supported by H-1 and FR-7.2.4.
The qualification that braking may be required to avoid collision directly connects P to the Evaluation Target.
P does not incorporate sensor failures, detection processes, braking-control mechanisms or their timing constraints.
